# mdtx [![build](https://img.shields.io/badge/build-passing-brightgreen)](https://example.com/ci) [![license](https://img.shields.io/badge/license-MIT-blue)](https://example.com/license)

An agent-based Markdown translation pipeline. See the
[documentation](https://example.com/docs) for details.

<!-- maintainers: keep this comment intact -->

## Why mdtx?

- AST-based validation, not regex hope
- Translation memory and resumable checkpoints
- Works with any OpenAI-compatible endpoint

## Quick start

```python
from mdtx import translate
translate("README.md", to="zh-CN")
```
